A toddler with pigtails, wearing a white t-shirt and blue shorts, crouches on the floor and points at the cat with a curious facial expression. (3) The toddler stands by the toy kitchen, touching the sink area. The orange cat continues to roll on its side, clutching and chewing the steak toy on the textured mat. (5) The girl sits on the mat and offers a blue fish-shaped toy to the orange cat. The cat looks away toward the camera, appearing uninterested in the toy as the girl holds it near its face.
